prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Pet Companion Journey", "Select whether you want to adopt a ready pet or design a unique custom desktop companion.", "Adopt Pre-made Pet", "Create Custom Pet"]
1: ["Signing in syncs your adopted pets safely to your cloud account across re-installs.", "Your account keeps your pets safe across updates and re-installs."]
2: ["Sign In to Save Your Desktop Companion", "Connect your account to save your companion's progress. If loading stalls, tap continue below.", "Continue with Account"]
3: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Your new desktop companion is officially ready to join your workspace!"]
4: ["Double check pet features before generating your final certificate."]
5: ["Preparing Desktop Companion", "We are launching your pet onto your desktop taskbar. Please keep the app open.", "If your pet doesn't appear on screen shortly, check system tray icons."]
6: ["Setting Up Your Workspace Pet", "Browse quick tips while your pet gets ready on your screen.", "Tip: You can move your pet anywhere on screen after setup.", "Initializing pet behavior engine..."]
7: ["Welcome Your Desktop Pet!", "Your pet is now active! Right-click your pet anytime to hide, configure controls, or chat.", "Right-click the desktop pet or system tray icon for control options."]
8: ["Your Companion is Ready", "Learn how to interact with your pet on your desktop workspace.", "Right-click to control", "Start Exploring"]
9: ["Begin Your Desktop Pet Journey", "Bring an animated companion to your desktop to keep you company while you work or study.", "Pick pre-made or fully custom pets on the next step!"]
